title.narrative: Reducing prevalence of forced labour in informal RMG factories in Bangladesh by promoting sustainable livelihood opportunities to people through alternative learning pathways

description.narrative:
The project aims to work both at destination where the informal factories are located; i.e. Keraniganj and Narayanganj and primary source locations: Barisal, Rangpur and Madaripur districts from where the people usually migrate at the destination areas and settle down at the informal factories as a ready-made garments' workers.
Therefore the target groups of this project are the factory owners of the informal garments and the workers there. Also the households and neighborhood people of the informal workers who have susceptibility to choose the informal-RMG sector as a profession at the source areas of Barisal, Rangpur and Madaripur.
To reduce the prevalance of forced labour in the informal ready-made garment factories of Bangladesh

activity-date.narrative: Due to the unprecedented COVID-19 effect the contract has been modified later and effective from 1st February 2021.
The project has come to a hard stop on this date due to FCDO's reduction of the GFEMS budget by 80%, in response to the UK's decision to reduce its ODA from 0.7% to 0.5%.

recipient-country.narrative: The approved grant money will be utilized for ameliorating the status of informal RMG factories and workers of Bangladesh which are situated at Keraniganj and Narayaganj. Also to put an end to the forced labour condition of these factories.
